source.name: Shift+Tab from the first control in a modal must wrap to the modal's last control

plan.root_cause: The modal's _enforceFocus method only prevents focus from leaving the modal by forcing it back to the modal element, but does not handle Tab/Shift+Tab cycling among the modal's internal focusable elements. When Shift+Tab is pressed from the first focusable element (#confirm-close), the browser moves focus to the previous element in the document (outside the modal), triggering _enforceFocus which returns focus to the modal container instead of the last focusable element (#confirm-delete).
plan.repair_strategy: Add a keydown handler on the modal element that traps Tab and Shift+Tab keys, cycling focus between the first and last focusable children of the modal. Install this handler when the modal is shown and remove it when hidden.

edits.before:
dispose() {
    [window, this._dialog]
      .forEach(htmlElement => EventHandler.off(htmlElement, EVENT_KEY))

    this._backdrop.dispose()
    super.dispose()

    /**
     * `document` has 2 events `EVENT_FOCUSIN` and `EVENT_CLICK_DATA_API`
     * Do not move `document` in `htmlElements` array
     * It will remove `EVENT_CLICK_DATA_API` event that should remain
     */
    EventHandler.off(document, EVENT_FOCUSIN)
  }

plan.expected_accessibility_effect: Shift+Tab from the first focusable element in the modal (close button) will wrap focus to the last focusable element (Delete button), and Tab from the last focusable element will wrap to the first, satisfying WCAG 2.1.1 (Keyboard) and 2.4.3 (Focus Order) for modal dialogs.
functional_risks: The focus trap handler may conflict with nested modals or other focus management scripts if multiple modals are open.
The focusable selector may not capture all focusable elements (e.g., custom elements with tabindex="0").
verification_requirements: Run the frozen journey: Shift+Tab from #confirm-close must land on #confirm-delete.
Focus must not escape the modal when Tab/Shift+Tab are pressed.
Existing keyboard dismissal (Escape) and backdrop click behavior must remain unchanged.
